title: Ebola death toll in DR Congo passes 5,000, Al Jazeera reports
detail: Al Jazeera reports the cumulative Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has passed 5,000, up from the 4,478 confirmed deaths in the CDC summary of ~17 October. Figures may mix confirmed and probable deaths; the underlying official report was not independently verified.

title: Ebola outbreak reported above 10,000 cases; CDC cited spread to Kenya and Nigeria
detail: A Google News-aggregated headline reports the outbreak has topped 10,000 cases and that the CDC cites spread to Kenya and Nigeria. Only the headline was available; the underlying outlet and the CDC figures were not verified. Nigeria involvement is not otherwise recorded in this tracker, and the CDC's last cited DRC count was 9,277 confirmed cases, so the 10,000 figure may include probable cases.
